title: Layer view
noLayer: No layer is on. Tick one in the Layers panel to see it here.
controls: Drag or swipe to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom, double-click to reset, click a layer for its numbers.

notes.columnTotals: Column totals are shown in the layer where most of the gas sits.
notes.flow: Flow directions are illustrative; there is no wind data.

columnTotal.general: This counts the gas in the whole column of air above the place. It is drawn in the layer that holds most of it.
columnTotal.expert: A total over the whole air column, shown in the layer where most of the gas sits.

flow: Particles travel from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”; the path is illustrative.
off: Switched off in the Layers panel; no particles drawn.
